mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS id, p.title AS title, p.cover_image AS coverImage, p.price AS price, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_wish_record r2 WHERE r2.product_id = p.id) AS wantCount FROM product_wish_record r LEFT JOIN product p ON r.product_id = p.id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.create_time DESC
